plan.archetype: Early damage and AoE into poison and Dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with upgraded AoE, sustained poison, Dexterity-backed block, and useful potions. Reduce follower pressure quickly; reserve Piercing Wail for dangerous multi-hit turns.
plan.summary: Prioritize efficient attacks and AoE now; add poison scaling and defensive powers next. Remove Strikes after securing damage. Take elites with potions and nearby recovery; upgrade key offense when HP permits.

plan.archetype: AoE burst and Dexterity defense, adding supported poison scaling
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Footwork and Echoing Slash when safe. Soften followers with Bomb, then chain kills. Bring multihit mitigation, reliable block, and useful potions.
plan.summary: Prioritize block, Weak, and draw over more basic attacks. Acquire poison sources before Accelerant. Heal now; upgrade key cards when safe. Keep elites near recovery and preserve boss-entry HP.
